identityPolicy.rule: Never merge INA and SIS identity traits. Use DUO frames as composition references, not as sole identity anchors.
identityPolicy.referenceStrategy: Select the smallest strong task-specific pack. Do not submit the full archive by default.
identityPolicy.metricPolicy: Never re-rank or demote an identity master from frameLaplacianVar.

frameLaplacianVar.meaning: Variance of the Laplacian over the entire frame, including background.
doNotUseFor: selecting between FACE and BODY frames
frameLaplacianVar.whyNot: Background texture dominates the value. FACE_FOUNDATION frames are shot against a smooth backdrop and score low; BODY frames contain stucco and tiled floor and score high. Audit v1.1 confirmed by control crop that the face frames are the SHARPER material despite the lower number.
safeUse: per-frame sanity check within one series and one captureType
